```{r}
create_map <- function(linhas = 16, colunas = 30, minas = 99)
{
quadrados = linhas*colunas
mapa_vetor = sample(c(rep(-1, minas), rep(0, quadrados-minas)), quadrados)
mapa_matrix = matrix(mapa_vetor, nrow = linhas, byrow = TRUE)

count_mines = function(i, j, matriz){
  if(matriz[i,j] == 0){
    count = 0
    for(n in -1:1){
      for(k in -1:1){
        if(matriz[i+n, j+k] == -1){count = count + 1}
      }
    }
    return(count)
  }
  else{return(-1)}
}

matriz_auxiliar = mapa_matrix
matriz_auxiliar = cbind(rep(-2, nrow(matriz_auxiliar)), matriz_auxiliar, rep(-2, nrow(matriz_auxiliar)))
matriz_auxiliar = rbind(rep(-2, ncol(matriz_auxiliar)), matriz_auxiliar, rep(-2, ncol(matriz_auxiliar)))

for(i in 1:linhas){
  for(j in 1:colunas){
    mapa_matrix[i, j] = count_mines(i+1, j+1, matriz_auxiliar)
  }
}
return(mapa_matrix)
}

create_interface <- function(linhas = 16, colunas = 30){
  interface = rep(" ", linhas*colunas)
  interface = matrix(interface, nrow = linhas)
  return(interface)
}
```

```{r}
reveal_neighbours <- function(matriz_auxiliar, vetori, vetorj){
  for(k in rep(1, length(vetori))){
    i = vetori[1] |> as.numeric()
    j = vetorj[1] |> as.numeric()
    vetori = vetori[-1] 
    vetorj = vetorj[-1]
    
    for(l in -1:1){
      for(m in -1:1){
        if(matriz_auxiliar[i+l,j+m] == 0 && matriz_auxiliar[i+l, j+m] != -2){
          vetori = c(vetori, i+l)
          vetorj = c(vetorj, j+m)
        }
        matriz_auxiliar[i+l, j+m] = "r"
      }
    }
  }
  lista = list(vetori, vetorj, matriz_auxiliar)
  return(lista)
}

reveal_zeros <- function(i, j, interface, mapa){
  vetori = c(i+1)
  vetorj = c(j+1)
  matriz_auxiliar = mapa
  matriz_auxiliar = cbind(rep(-2, nrow(matriz_auxiliar)), matriz_auxiliar, rep(-2, nrow(matriz_auxiliar)))
  matriz_auxiliar = rbind(rep(-2, ncol(matriz_auxiliar)), matriz_auxiliar, rep(-2, ncol(matriz_auxiliar)))
  
  while(length(vetori) != 0){
    resultado = reveal_neighbours(matriz_auxiliar, vetori, vetorj)
    matriz_auxiliar = unlist(resultado[[3]])
    vetori = unlist(resultado[[1]])
    vetorj = unlist(resultado[[2]])
  }
  
  matriz_auxiliar = matriz_auxiliar[,-1]
  matriz_auxiliar = matriz_auxiliar[,-ncol(matriz_auxiliar)]
  matriz_auxiliar = matriz_auxiliar[-1,]
  matriz_auxiliar = matriz_auxiliar[-nrow(matriz_auxiliar),]
  
  mapa_vetor = as.vector(mapa)
  interface_vetor = as.vector(interface)
  aux_vetor = as.vector(matriz_auxiliar)
  
  for(m in 1:length(aux_vetor)){
    if(aux_vetor[m] == "r"){
      interface_vetor[m] = mapa_vetor[m]
    }
  }
  
  interface = matrix(interface_vetor, nrow = nrow(interface))
  
  return(interface)
}

click_reveal <- function(i, j, interface, mapa){
  if(mapa[i, j] == 0){
    interface = reveal_zeros(i, j, interface, mapa)
    return(interface)
  }
  else{
    interface[i, j] = mapa[i, j]
    return(interface)
  }
}
```

```{r}
mapa = create_map()
interface = create_interface()
```

```{r}
interface = click_reveal(2,3, interface, mapa)
```

```{r}
library(neuralnet)
library(caret)

lista_puzzles = list()
lista_solucoes = list()

vetor_puzz <- function(x){
  for(n in 1:length(x)){
    sorte = sample(0:1, 1)
    if(sorte == 0){
      x[n] = 99
    }
  }
  return(x)
}

positive_to_zero <- function(matriz){
  matriz[matriz >= 0] <- 0
  return(matriz)
}

for(n in 1:10000){
  n_minas = sample(3:8, 1)
  mapa = create_map(linhas = 5, colunas = 5, minas = n_minas) |> as.vector()
  lista_puzzles[[n]] = mapa |> vetor_puzz()
  lista_solucoes[[n]] = mapa |> positive_to_zero()
}

puzzles = do.call(rbind, lista_puzzles)
solucoes = do.call(rbind, lista_solucoes)
```

```{r}
train_index = sample(1:nrow(solucoes), nrow(solucoes)*0.8)
train_puzzles <- puzzles[train_index, ]
train_solutions <- solucoes[train_index, ]
test_puzzles <- puzzles[-train_index, ]
test_solutions <- solucoes[-train_index, ]

train_puzzles <- scale(train_puzzles)
test_puzzles <- scale(test_puzzles)

train_puzzles = cbind(train_puzzles, train_solutions)
test_puzzles = cbind(test_puzzles, test_solutions)
```

```{r}
nn <- neuralnet(V26 + V27 + V28 + V29 + V30 + V31 + V32 + V33 +
                V34 + V35 + V36 + V37 + V38 + V39 + V40 + V41 +
                V42 + V43 + V44 + V45 + V46 + V47 + V48 + V49 + V50 ~.,
                data = train_puzzles[1:1000,], hidden = c(20), threshold = 0.05, linear.output = TRUE, lifesign = "full")
```

```{r}
library(rpart)

tree <- rpart(V26 + V27 + V28 + V29 + V30 + V31 + V32 + V33 +
              V34 + V35 + V36 + V37 + V38 + V39 + V40 + V41 +
              V42 + V43 + V44 + V45 + V46 + V47 + V48 + V49 + V50 ~.,
              data = train_puzzles |> as.data.frame(), method = "class")
```

```{r}
for(i in 26:50){
  treex <- rpart(V26~., data = train_puzzles[,c(1:25, i)] |> as.data.frame(), method = "class")
  assign(paste0("tree", i), treex)
}
```

```{r}
for(j in 26:50){
  vartree <- get(paste0("tree", j))
  predx <- predict(vartree, test_puzzles[,1:25] |> as.data.frame(), type = "class")
  assign(paste0("pred", j), predx)
}
```

```{r}
dfpreds <- cbind(pred26, pred27, pred28, pred29, pred30, pred31, pred32, pred33, pred34, pred35, pred36, pred37, pred38, pred39, pred40, pred41, pred42, pred43, pred44, pred45, pred46, pred47, pred48, pred49, pred50) |> as.data.frame()

names(dfpreds) <- paste0("V", 1:25)
```

```{r}
table(unlist(dfpreds) |> as.vector(), unlist(test_solutions) |> as.vector())
```


```{r}
predictions <- predict(tree, test_puzzles[1:2,1:25] |> as.data.frame(), type = "class")
confusionMatrix(predictions, test_solutions[1,])
```
